name: Alpaca
tagline: Commission-free stock trading API for algo trading and market data
description: Alpaca provides a commission-free stock and crypto trading API with market data, paper trading, and brokerage services. Developers use REST and WebSocket endpoints for equities, options, and crypto trading, account management, and real-time market data.

auth.details: API key and secret via APCA-API-KEY-ID and APCA-API-SECRET-KEY headers; self-serve signup

use_cases: get brokerage account equity and cash balance
place a market order for a stock
list open positions in a portfolio
